g.text: Put C1 and C2 at the CC1101 VCC and GND pins.

g.desc: Put C1 and C2 at the CC1101 VCC and GND pins.

g.text: ANT: 315 MHz antenna, or a 23.8 cm wire on modules with a solder pad.

g.desc: ANT: 315 MHz antenna, or a 23.8 cm wire on modules with a solder pad.

g.text: Power from pin 17 (3.3 V), never pin 2 or 4 (5 V). Check the pin order against your module's silkscreen.

g.desc: Power from pin 17 (3.3 V), never pin 2 or 4 (5 V). Check the pin order against your module's silkscreen.

g.text: Enable SPI: dtparam=spi=on in /boot/firmware/config.txt. CSN uses CE0 (/dev/spidev0.0).

g.desc: Enable SPI: dtparam=spi=on in /boot/firmware/config.txt. CSN uses CE0 (/dev/spidev0.0).

g.text: GDO0 and GDO2 are spare inputs, wired for listening to the real remote later.
